title: Property complaints surge 50% as AI reshapes disputes
summary:
Property complaints to The Property Ombudsman have increased by more than 50% in the first half of this year compared to 2024. The surge is driven by greater consumer awareness, regulatory reform and the increasing use of AI tools to prepare detailed submissions.

title: India leads overseas funds in UK property transactions
summary:
One in ten homebuyers in the UK are using funds originating overseas to finance all or part of their property purchase, according to data from client due diligence firm Thirdfort. India, the USA, Hong Kong, Italy and China are the five most common countries where money is coming from for UK property transactions.

title: Sales stock rises while rental properties decline in May
summary:
UK housing market data for May 2026 shows sales stock increased to 44 properties per branch while rental properties declined to 12.09 per branch. Prospective buyer registrations fell to 64 per branch, with 84% of properties selling below asking price.

title: Berkeley Group offers school fee incentive at London site
summary:
Berkeley Group is offering to cover private school fees for buyers at its Trent Park development in Enfield, north London, as housebuilders deploy sales incentives amid weakening demand in the capital's property market.

title: Economics YouTuber Gary Stevenson steps back from content
summary:
Gary Stevenson, the economics commentator with 1.6 million YouTube subscribers, has announced he is stepping back from content creation citing burnout. The move comes as the UK prepares to implement the Mansion Tax on properties valued over £2 million from April 2028.

title: Labour MP Kelly Foy appointed to housing minister role
summary:
Mary Kelly Foy MP has been appointed Parliamentary Private Secretary to Housing Minister Matthew Pennycook. The Durham MP has previously campaigned on private rental standards and social housing provision.

title: Cubica Capital secures £6.8m for Sidcup conversion
summary:
Cubica Capital has secured £6.8 million from Secure Trust Bank Real Estate Finance to refinance a converted office building in Sidcup, south-east London. The five-year facility covers Roxby House, a five-storey building originally designed by post-war architect Owen Luder.

title: Recognise Bank completes £2.95m Shrewsbury refinance
summary:
Recognise Bank has provided a £2.95 million bridging loan to refinance an office-to-residential conversion in Shrewsbury. The facility enabled the developer to repay existing development finance before its expiry and complete the final project stages.

title: AI lettings firm Dwelly secures £125m funding round
summary:
AI-powered lettings business Dwelly has secured £125 million in funding to support its acquisition strategy of independent letting agencies and expand its technology platform. The funding round was co-led by EQT Growth and General Catalyst, comprising $95 million in equity and a further $75 million through an expanded debt facility from Trinity Capital.

title: Lender provides £945k for guesthouse to HMO conversion
summary:
Avamore Capital has provided a £945,000 refurbishment loan to convert a former guesthouse into a house of multiple occupancy. The lender adapted its loan structure when planning approval was delayed by a month, conducting a commercial valuation to prevent completion delays.
